items.title: Marty Grosz interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 4, 1995
items.q: Of course, Ellington’s band, because I’d read a little bit and heard a little bit, I’d heard some old records, that was a particular thrill

ctx.x: Well you had a good thing to listen to with Freddie Green.

You know I went to see bands. I listened to everything. Phil Spitalny and his All-Girl Orchestra, Charlie Spivak, Glen Grey and the Casa Loma Orchestra, Duke Ellington, Bobby Sherwood, a wonderful guitar player that nobody knows about that he was a fine guitar player, sort of buried in the studios. But on this occasion he played some very good guitar but basically he was a trumpet player with the band. That was it, he double played all the instruments. Anything. I’d go to see anything just to see how they did it.…
